response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced senior engineer with genuine low-latency systems work (DLang micro-services handling millions of requests/second) and strong testing culture, but falls well short of the core minimum qualifications: only about six months of professional C++ (National Instruments) versus the required 8 years, and no sustained large-scale cloud compute platform or formal technical-leadership track record. Most of his career centers on full-stack web development (TypeScript/Node.js), which does not map to leading technical strategy for an internal C++-heavy cloud compute platform.
strengths: High-performance distributed systems experience at Dunnhumby (async I/O, low-latency services at scale)
Strong software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, testing frameworks, and open-source contributions
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing via workshops, courses, and code katas
concerns: Far below the required 8 years of C++ experience (~6 months professionally)
No formal technical-lead role managing priorities, deadlines, or cross-team alignment
Limited production cloud architecture / compute-infrastructure depth (mostly full-stack web work)

key_factors.factor: Lack of formal technical leadership experience
